COLDWAR_ITA_party_politics_category = {
	COLDWAR_ITA_socialist_unity = {
		icon = GFX_decision_generic_political_discourse
		allowed = { original_tag = ITA }
		visible = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ITA_socialist_unity }
			check_variable = { party_pop_array^18 > 0 }
		}
		available = {
			check_variable = { party_pop_array^18 > party_pop_array^3 }
			OR = {
				neutrality_neutral_social_are_in_power = yes
				is_in_array = { gov_coalition_array = 18 }
			}
			has_stability > 0.39
			has_war = no
		}
		cost = 100
		days_remove = 60
		fire_only_once = yes
		complete_effect = {
			log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: Decision COLDWAR_ITA_socialist_unity"
			custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_ITA_socialist_unity_tt
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ITA_socialist_unity
			hidden_effect = {
				set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ITA_unity_total = party_pop_array^3 }
				add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ITA_unity_total = party_pop_array^18 }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ITA_unity_total = 0.01 }
				set_variable = { party_pop_array^3 = COLDWAR_ITA_unity_total }
				set_variable = { party_pop_array^18 = 0.01 }
				if = { limit = { is_in_array = { gov_coalition_array = 18 } } remove_from_array = { gov_coalition_array = 18 } if = { limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { gov_coalition_array = 3 } } NOT = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 3 } } } add_to_array = { gov_coalition_array = 3 } } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 18 } } set_temp_variable = { rul_party_temp = 3 } change_ruling_party_effect = yes }
				recalculate_party = yes
				update_government_coalition_strength = yes
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = {
			base = 1
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_ITA_socialist_split = {

				add_to_variable = { party_pop_array^18 = COLDWAR_ITA_unity_total }

			}
		}
		ai_will_do = {
			base = 1
		}
	}
